Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

You'll own the full sales cycle—prospecting to close—for enterprise and Global 2000 organisations across the UK and Benelux in financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, and enterprise software. Sovereignty and control over where data and models reside are growing priorities across these sectors, and Cohere is well positioned to meet that need with private, on-premise and in-country deployment built for enterprise scale.

This is a territory with significant scope to build. You'll shape how we cover Benelux, work closely with our partner ecosystem to extend reach, and take Cohere deeper into UK and Northern European enterprise. Pipeline generation sits with you. This is a hunter role for someone who takes pride in building their own book rather than working leads handed to them.

This is a highly autonomous role demanding ownership of multi-million-dollar territories. You'll navigate intricate decision-making processes, educate C-suite stakeholders, and position Cohere as a strategic AI partner. Your insights will directly shape our product evolution, helping us prioritise features that drive enterprise adoption.

As a Sr. Account Executive, you will:

  • Drive net-new customer acquisition across the UK and Benelux via targeted outbound activity, executive introductions, and relationship building with key stakeholders

  • Support coverage of adjacent Northern European accounts as territory priorities require

  • Generate and own your own pipeline through disciplined outbound, research and executive prospecting

  • Be a trusted advisor to customer prospects, deeply understand their challenges & goals, and tailor solutions to drive impact for their businesses

  • Position Cohere's private, on-premise and in-country deployment options against the data residency, sovereignty and regulatory requirements of UK and European enterprise buyers, including the EU AI Act

  • Leverage senior-level relationships with executives to drive strategic partnerships and sales opportunities

  • Align closely with our partners and systems integrators to drive shared revenue and extend reach into target accounts

  • Work cross-functionally across the business, drawing in the right technical and specialist colleagues as each engagement requires

  • Collaborate with Cohere's Product and Engineering teams on strategic motions to deliver solutions to large enterprise customers

  • Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives and Marketing to supplement your own top of funnel activity

  • Own the full sales cycle – from initial outreach, technical and business validation, through deal close

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Fluent English; Dutch is an advantage

  • 10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with Global 2000 and large enterprise customers along with experience negotiating & closing transformational 7-figure deals

  • Depth in at least two of our priority sectors: financial services, telecommunications, energy and utilities, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, enterprise software

  • A hunter mentality - you take pride in generating your own pipeline and are at your best when building a territory rather than managing an inherited one

  • A proven track record of high performance and exceeding quotas

  • Fluency with MEDDPICC - you qualify rigorously, can speak to metrics, economic buyer, decision criteria and process, champion and competition on any deal in your book, and keep that detail current in CRM so the forecast holds up to scrutiny

  • Experience building and maintaining senior-level relationships with executives

  • Experience selling complex enterprise level solutions, technical products, and private or on-premise deployments (AI/NLP solutions preferred)

  • Familiarity with UK and European data residency, sovereignty and regulatory requirements as live buying criteria

  • Experience working alongside channel partners and systems integrators to drive sales cycles and hit shared revenue goals

  • High tolerance for ambiguity - you'll need to be both a doer and a strategist, comfortable building your own approach rather than working to a pre-set one

  • Highly organized - this is a high activity role involving multiple team members and you are responsible for keeping everyone on track

  • Creativity - deal structures can widely vary, strong technical acumen and the ability to creatively structure mutually beneficial partnerships are necessary

  • Excellent communication skills - you are a great listener, have a knack for understanding what matters most to others & building strong relationships, experienced presenting to a C-suite audience, and feel comfortable speaking to both technical and non-technical customer prospects

  • Willingness to travel across the UK, Benelux and elsewhere in Northern Europe as required

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Machine Learning & AI at Trainline 👋

Machine learning and AI are at the core of how Trainline is transforming travel, helping millions of customers make smarter, more sustainable journeys every day. Our ML models and AI solutions power critical aspects of our platform, including:

  • Advanced search and recommendations capabilities across our mobile and web applications

  • Pricing and routing optimisations to find the best fares for customers

  • Personalised user experiences enhanced by agentic AI

  • Data-driven digital marketing systems

  • AI agents improving customer support

Our machine learning teams own the complete delivery lifecycle from ideation to production. We work closely with stakeholders across the business to expand the understanding and impact of machine learning and AI throughout Trainline.

About The Role

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers to join our team help shape the future of train travel. You’ll be joining a high-performing, deeply technical community of Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers to tackle complex problems by combining Trainline’s rich datasets with cutting edge algorithms. What unites our team is an expertise in the field, a love of what we do and the desire to create impactful solutions to support Trainline’s goals of encouraging sustainable travel.

As a part of Trainline you will be joining an environment where learning and development is top priority. You will have the opportunity to work with fellow ML & AI enthusiasts on large-scale production systems, delivering highly impactful products that make a difference to our millions of customers.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Trainline you will... 🚄

  • Work in cross-functional teams combining data scientists, software, data and machine learning engineers, and product managers

  • Design and deliver machine learning models and/or AI solutions at scale that drive measurable impact for Trainline

  • Own the full end-to-end machine learning delivery lifecycle including data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and tuning, offline and online evaluation, deployments and maintenance

  • Partner with stakeholders to propose innovative data products that leverage Trainline’s extensive datasets and state of the art algorithms

  • Create the tools, frameworks and libraries that enables the acceleration of our ML & AI products delivery and improve our workflows

  • Take an active part in our AI and ML community and foster a culture of rigorous learning and experimentation

We'd love to hear from you if you...🔍

  • Have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a similar quantitative discipline

  • Are proficient with Python, including open-source data libraries (e.g Pandas, Numpy, Scikit learn etc.)

  • Have experience productionising machine learning models and/or AI solutions

  • Are an expert in one of predictive modelling, classification, regression, optimisation, NLP algorithms or recommendation systems

  • Have experience with Spark

  • Have knowledge of DevOps technologies such as Docker and Terraform and ML Ops practices and platforms like ML Flow

  • Have experience with agile delivery methodologies and CI/CD processes and tools

  • Have a broad of understanding of data extraction, data manipulation and feature engineering techniques

  • Are familiar with statistical methodologies

  • Have great communication skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience with transport industry and/or geographical information systems (GIS)

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure

  • Experience with Large Language Models (fine tuning, RAG, agents)

  • Experience with graph technology and/or algorithms

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. data.description:
Senior Product Engineer

 

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

About the Role

This is a Senior Product Engineer role in Fleek's product engineering team, working across the stack. You'll report into our CTO, Sanket Agarwal (ex-Google, Postmates), and work embedded with a product manager and designer in a small, senior squad focused on the core marketplace experience.

Why This Role Stands Out

Fleek is digitising an industry that has never had technology. There are no existing playbooks for building an ecommerce experience around secondhand fashion at wholesale scale, where every item is unique, inventory is unpredictable, quality is graded by AI, and the supply chain spans three continents. You will be designing how the transaction layer works for a market that hasn't existed before.

You will be on our Growth team, owning the ecommerce journey from discovery to checkout, payment and credit systems, order management, and seller tools. Your systems will handle 500,000+ items a month today and million+ by the end of the year.

AI is at the core of everything we do, so you'll work closely with our data and AI teams to build the product features and services that connect FleekSort's classification engine to the marketplace experience.

We're looking for a product engineer who can think about how systems affect buyers and sellers at scale. You'll be expected to understand the business problems your code solves, and challenge whether we're solving the right ones.

What Makes You a Fleek Product Engineer?

  • Product-Obsessed Builder: You think about what the seller sees when their inventory goes live, or why a buyer drops off at checkout. You instinctively connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: We're building systems for workflows that didn't exist before Fleek. You thrive when the problem is undefined and collaboration is key.

  • Customer-Focused Thinker: You understand the dynamics of customer platforms and can understand how technical choices affect customers and our broader marketplace.

  • Owner, Not Renter: You take a feature from problem definition to production and monitor it afterwards.

  • Startup Pace: You've worked in environments where shipping matters more than perfection, where you deploy daily, and where velocity is a competitive advantage.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Ecommerce Journey: Design and build the features and systems powering Fleek's core marketplace, across frontend and backend, from item discovery and search through to checkout, payment, and post-purchase. These are product features that directly drive GMV.

  • Integrate AI into the Product: Build the features and services that connect FleekSort's AI classification engine to the marketplace experience, ensuring grading, pricing, and categorisation flow seamlessly into listings, search, and buyer workflows.

  • Design for Scale: Architect systems that handle 500K+ items per month today, with a clear path to millions. Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed of delivery and long-term scalability.

  • Shape Technical Direction: Contribute to architectural decisions across the stack. Challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and help define engineering standards for a fast-growing team.

  • Mentor and Elevate: Support the growth of more junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. Help raise the technical bar across the team.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work embedded with your product manager and designer to define what gets built. Partner with data, AI, and operations teams to turn complex real-world logistics into reliable, scalable software.

What You Bring

  • A track record of shipping product: You've built and owned user-facing features end to end, at a marketplace, fintech or consumer company; we care more about what you've shipped than how many years it took.

  • You start from the user: You talk to buyers and sellers, watch where they get stuck, and can explain why what you're building matters to the person using it.

  • You think like a PM: You shape the problem as well as the solution, push back when something doesn't feel right, and tie your work to GMV, conversion or retention.

  • You ship fast and learn: You'd rather put a working version in front of users this week than a perfect one next quarter, and you're used to deploying daily.

  • You measure what you build: You define success before you start and use data, user feedback and experiments to decide what to build next.

  • You build AI-native: You use AI tools every day to move faster, and you've shipped features on LLMs or ML models, with evals to know they work.

  • You work across the stack: You're strong in TypeScript and Node.js and comfortable enough on the frontend and in the data layer to ship a feature end to end, whichever way you lean.

  • You have sound judgement: You make sensible trade-offs between speed and scale, think about failure modes in systems that move real money, and know when good enough is good enough.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketplace dynamics: two-sided platforms, pricing, trust, supply-demand matching

  • Familiarity with international systems and distributed teams across multiple time zones

A genuine excitement for building something from scratch in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

This Role Isn't for You If You Want:

  • Narrow, siloed ownership where you only touch one service and never see the user

  • Detailed specs handed to you before you start, we define problems together

  • A slow-moving, highly structured environment with long release cycles

  • Fully remote work, this team is on-site in London 3-4 days per week

  • Pure infrastructure or platform work with no product exposure

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, Commercial St, E1 (Liverpool St / Aldgate East)

  • Work model: On-site

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan

  • Stack: TypeScript and Node.js across frontend and backend, AI/ML integration

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

What's In It for You?

Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for a $350 billion market that has never been digitised. Joining now means you'll be part of the team that defines how the secondhand economy works, at scale, globally.

Why people join Fleek

  • The problem is real: 9 million items saved from landfill since 2022. Your work has tangible, measurable impact.

  • The AI is genuinely novel: FleekSort is an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, turning an opaque manual trade into a structured global inventory layer. This isn't a GPT wrapper.

  • The growth is exceptional: Tripling year-on-year, ~$50M raised, Series B closed. Backed by a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, with advisors from Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

  • The timing is perfect: The secondhand market is projected to reach $350B by 2027. EU regulation is mandating the infrastructure Fleek builds. You're catching a wave.

  • You'll have real ownership: 100-person company, no bureaucracy. You'll shape decisions and see the impact of your work immediately.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

data.description:
About Level Zero
Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health.

Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are.

We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.
 

About the Role

We are seeking a lead biosensor scientist to drive the development and commercialisation of our continuous aptamer sensor platform. The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in developing continuous monitoring devices for regulated healthcare applications, demonstrated experience transitioning research-stage sensors into manufacturing-ready products, and a track record working with in vivo validation studies and large-scale analytical verification programs.

This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London.


What you'll do
  • Lead the development and optimisation of electrochemical continuous sensor systems from bench concept through manufacturing readiness.
  • Design and execute large-scale analytical verification studies, including multi-parameter performance characterisation, stability assessments, and biocompatibility validation.
  • Oversee in vivo validation studies in human subjects and troubleshoot sensor performance in clinical settings.
  • Define manufacturing processes, material specifications, and quality control parameters aligned with regulatory expectations and QMS frameworks.
  • Engage directly with regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) to define performance specifications and shape submission strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional efforts with electrochemistry, microfabrication, and manufacturing to translate designs into scalable production.
  • Develop technical documentation packages (CMC, analytical performance dossiers) for regulatory submissions and investor communications.
  • Mentor junior scientists and technicians in sensor characterisation and assay validation methodologies.

    • What You Bring
  • A Ph.D. degree in electrochemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or related discipline, with specific focus on electrochemical biosensors. Minimum 4 years of industry experience commercialising continuous monitoring or diagnostic sensor technologies.

    • The ideal candidate will possess expertise in the following areas:

  • Deep experience in electrochemical sensor development-particularly amperometric, potentiometric, or impedance-based platforms-with demonstrated progression from research concept to clinical or commercial application.
  • Proven track record managing regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking) for continuous monitoring devices.
  • Strong experience designing and executing large-scale analytical verification studies including stability, accuracy, precision, and matrix interference assessments.

  • Knowledge of manufacturing readiness, scale-up strategy, and GMP-compatible processes.
  • Proven ability to operate in QMS-ready environments with familiarity of ISO 13485, design controls, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Understanding of biocompatibility, sterility, and shelf-life requirements for implantable or skin-worn continuous devices.
  • Proficiency in surface chemistry, material selection, and biointerface optimisation.
  • Expertise in aptamer-based biorecognition elements and aptamer optimisation for continuous monitoring applications.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience with microneedle or transdermal ISF technologies.
  • Familiarity with SELEX or aptamer discovery workflows.

At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

Be the final safeguard between production and launch 

 

What this really means is that we are looking for a quality inspector to be the last line of defense in ensuring that our raw materials, components, and assets meet the industry-established safety, regulatory and compliance standards, whilst being conscious of fast-moving business priorities. 


What You'll Do:
The Quality Inspector is charged with verifying mission-critical components, sub-assemblies and systems meet strict regulatory standards such as AS9100. 
  • You will perform final inspections against engineering drawings, CAD models and Inspections and Test Plans (ITPs) and compile First Article Inspection Reports whilst following AS9102 standards 
  • You will manually verify tolerances using tools such as micrometres or via advanced testing equipment such as 3D optical scanners. 
  • You will maintain an unbroken audit trail by verifying all supplier Certificates of Conformity, test reports and batch records 
  • You will be responsible for maintaining calibration logs for inspection tooling as well as supporting internal/customer audits 

    • Who You Are:
  • 3-6 years experience working within quality assurance at inspector level, with a Degree, apprenticeship or equivalent experience in supply chain, business, engineering, manufacturing or operations. 
  • You possess proven hands-on experience across precision manufacturing, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, electronics assembly within a highly regulated industry 
  • You possess a working knowledge of industry quality and security standards such as AS9100 for manufacturing, AS9110 for maintenance or AS9120 for distribution 
  • You will have experience with and the ability to read complex engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs) and 3D CAD models.  Experience working with manual verification tools such as micrometres, digital callipers and advanced measurements tools will be beneficial 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, ERP systems such as SAP is advantageous 
  • High attention to detail with the ability to hold firm against safety-critical standards amid production pressure and time constraints with the ability to communicate clearly and often 
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.  Proficiency in additional languages may be beneficial.

  • Exposure to the full lifecycle of complex defence programmes, from customer requirements and commercial strategy through to engineering delivery and flight testing.

  • High ownership and autonomy: no time tracking and no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

data.description:
The Opportunity

This isn’t just a Sales Development role — it’s your chance to be the engine of Sitetracker’s pipeline growth during a high-impact period. As a French-speaking Senior Sales Development Representative, you’ll address the critical business need of generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline in our EMEA region. With increased investment and focus on international expansion, your efforts will directly influence revenue growth and market penetration in this dynamic, fast-paced environment. You’ll be stepping into a role with visibility, autonomy, and the support to shape how Sitetracker connects with prospective customers across London, Spain, and beyond. If you’re driven by the challenge of building scalable outbound strategies and crave the opportunity to make a measurable difference — this is it.


What You’ll Do

As a Senior SDR, you’ll play a pivotal front-line role in Sitetracker’s sales ecosystem. You’ll consistently generate high-quality leads and pipeline through thoughtful, targeted outreach, becoming a true partner to our account executives and a trusted voice to our prospects. This isn’t a “smile and dial” environment — it’s a career-defining opportunity to take ownership of your region and make strategic decisions about where and how we go to market. You’ll collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to refine messaging, run account-based plays, and experiment with new channels and approaches. Your success will be measured not just by volume, but by the business value of the opportunities you surface. In short, you won’t just be booking meetings — you’ll be driving real, scalable impact.


The Skills You’ll Have


1. Operational Discipline & Consistency

  • Build and follow a consistent daily rhythm to drive pipeline generation and CRM hygiene
  • Use time-blocking and focused outreach methods to hit high-volume targets
  • Demonstrate follow-through on multi-touch outreach campaigns with measurable results
  • Log activity and outcomes meticulously to create visibility and enable coaching
  • Maintain clean Salesforce records and proactively flag blockers or risks

2. Outbound Prospecting Excellence

  • Drive outbound pipeline creation using a mix of phone, email, and social touchpoints
  • Execute persona-driven messaging that resonates across geographies
  • Customize outreach for Tier 1 accounts and apply insights to scale for Tier 2/3

3. Resilience & Mindset

  • Maintain momentum and positivity through high-rejection outreach environments
  • Rebound from challenges by leveraging data and coaching for continuous improvement

  • Consistently exceed quota and activity metrics through focused execution

  • Demonstrate accountability through clean Salesforce tracking and proactive updates

  • Exceed pipeline goals through creative outbound strategies and consistent execution

  • Identify and overcome barriers in specific markets or verticals

data.description:
Level Up Your Career!
 
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.
 
At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Royal London Pension, a Free On-site Gym, Dog-friendly Office, LinkedIn Learning, 25 holiday days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra holiday for each year of service capped at 5.

Join The Team!

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to steer User Acquisition across our mobile portfolio: live hits, much-loved classics, and exciting new games looking for their big break.

We’ll shape the title around your experience, from Senior UA Manager to Lead UA Manager or even Head of UA, because it’s the impact that matters.

This role is for you if you’re a hands-on UA leader who gets a real buzz from spotting where the next profitable pound of spend is hiding, and proving it. You’ll grow a team of UA Managers who proudly own their games, and bring an investor’s eye to the whole portfolio so every game and every campaign earns its place in the spotlight.

This role is based on-site 5 days per week at our Leamington Spa studio, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation. 


What You’ll Do:
  • Steer portfolio UA. Set the UA strategy across our games and channels, and put every pound where it works hardest.
  • Grow a brilliant team. Lead and coach our UA Managers, give each of them clear ownership of their games, and help them do the best work of their careers.
  • Unlock profitable scale. Find the games ready to grow faster, and move quickly when something isn’t paying back.
  • Keep targets sharp. Work with our analytics team on LTV and ROAS targets, and bring a healthy challenge when the numbers don’t add up.
  • Power the creative engine. Partner with our creative and analytics teams so every game has a steady flow of fresh ads being tested, learned from, and scaled.
  • Give new games a fair shot. Run clean, consistent market tests for our new game ideas so we can spot the winners early.
  • Be the UA voice in our game teams. Share what the market is telling us with producers, product, and monetisation, and turn game improvements into more growth.
  • Build great partnerships. Work closely with ad networks and platforms, and keep exploring new channels

    • What You’ll Own:

    Profitable growth across our portfolio. You’ll be the go-to owner of how our games grow: spotting opportunities first, catching dips early, keeping targets sharp, and helping your team stay on top of every game they own.

    How we’ll celebrate your success:
  • Profitable spend and installs at or above target payback
  • ROAS and payback against target
  • UA contribution to profit across the portfolio

data.title: Merchandise Planning & Analytics Analyst
data.description:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 

LONDON
Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events.

COMMERICAL
We're partnering with global brands and the most influential and renowned boutique curators to bring our customers an unrivalled range of fashion to empower their individuality. We’re relationship builders, we’re solution finders and we’re analysts. We work with all areas of the FARFETCH business to improve our social and environmental impact while delivering business success. We want to empower our consumers to buy better, improve our operational footprint, and explore new business models that improve our impact. 

THE ROLE
The Merchandise Planning & Analytics team supports the growth of key supply channels and brand partnerships on FARFETCH through commercial planning and data-driven insights.
As a Merchandise Planning & Analytics Analyst, you will support the team in analysing business performance, identifying opportunities to optimise supply and maximising sales. You will contribute to pre-season planning and in-season trading, while developing analytical tools and processes to support better commercial decision-making.
Working closely with colleagues across Brand Partnerships, Business Development, Online Merchandising, Marketing, Operations, Product and Business Insights, you will help translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Analytics

  • Analyse sales, stock and demand performance across brands, channels, regions, categories and products, identifying key trends and commercial opportunities.

  • Produce actionable insights and recommendations to optimise supply, improve product availability and maximise sales.

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and analytical tools, working with BI and other technical teams to improve business visibility.

  • Support analysis of key commercial initiatives, including markdown optimisation, next-day delivery and exclusive products.

  • Present findings through regular trade meetings, business reviews and project updates.

  • Support with ad-hoc analysis and requests from senior management and business development

    • Planning

  • Support Merchandise Planning & Analytics managers in pre-season planning for key brand partners, using historical performance and demand trends to inform supply and assortment recommendations.

  • Refresh and maintain sales forecasting and planning models, supporting target setting and scenario analysis.

  • Monitor sales and stock performance against targets and forecasts, identifying risks and opportunities.

  • Identify supply opportunities and recommend actions to improve product availability and maximise sales.

  • Support ongoing forecasting and planning updates, contributing to the development of more effective planning models and processes


    • WHO YOU ARE

  • Collaborative, flexible and approachable, with pride in the quality of your work and an understanding that how you work is just as important as what you deliver.

  • Previous experience in Merchandise Planning, Buying, Demand or Supply Planning, Analytics or Consulting, ideally within the fashion or luxury industry.

  • An understanding of the fashion and luxury industry and its commercial drivers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data analysis using large data sets .

  • Excellent planning and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail.

  • Commercially minded, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

  • Proactive and curious, with the ability to identify opportunities and challenge existing ways of working.

  • Comfortable managing competing priorities and working to deadlines in a fast-paced environment, ability to escalate challenges to management

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the understanding of how  present findings clearly to different audiences.

  • Technical skills for processing and analysing large amounts of data:

  • Excel (mid level) and SQL (preferred, basic level) .

  • Looker or equivalent BI tools (desirable).

  • Employee Pension Scheme

data.title: Field Operations Manager, EMEA
data.description:
About Exa

Exa is an applied AI research lab organizing the entire web for AI. Agents don't search like people do. They ask long, complex questions and need clean, accurate, real-time answers. So we train our own retrieval models and index hundreds of billions of webpages, giving agents grounded, cited answers instead of stale training data.

And it's working. We've grown about 10x a year for three years, to more than $100M in annualized revenue and 2B+ requests a month from 200K+ teams. HubSpot, monday.com, Revolut, Firefox, Cognition, Cursor and OpenRouter all build on Exa. We raised a $250M Series C at a $2.2B valuation, led by a16z with Benchmark, Lightspeed, NVIDIA Ventures and Y Combinator.

If you want to build core technology that's used every day, help build a generational company, and shape the revenue engine behind it, come join us.

About the role

Exa is hiring a Senior Field Operations Manager for EMEA, based in our new London office, to be the go-to partner for our EMEA sales leader, AEs, SDRs, partners and field engineers as the region grows from a handful of people into a full team.

You’ll bring our GTM operations and programs to EMEA, partnering with our Head of Revenue Programs to decide what we keep, what we localize and what we build new for the region’s markets.

You’ll be a swiss army knife across process, change management, light deal desk, insights and tools, with the relationships and judgment to tie it all together.

If you’ve helped build ops in a new region and you love being close to the field, we’d love to talk!

What you'll do

You'll lean hard on AI across all of this. We expect AI to do much of the reporting, drafting and checking, so your time goes to the field and the conversations only a person can have.

  • Be the person our EMEA sales leader and team go to first. Listen for what matters to them, flag it, help them prioritize, and turn their problems into programs that stick.

  • Stay really close to our EMEA AEs, SDRs, partners and field engineers. Know what’s working and what’s not, and work with our Insights team to spot patterns early, before they show up in the numbers.

  • Roll out every change in EMEA, localized for our markets. Think through what each change will affect, and give each one a clear why, a playbook, training and a check-in on whether it stuck.

  • Run EMEA’s operating rhythm: weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, QBR-style reviews and planning inputs, with decisions and follow-ups tracked.

  • Help EMEA deals move through pricing, quoting and approvals with our US deal desk, Finance and Legal, including EMEA specifics like VAT, GDPR and local entities.

  • Take our operations and programs from launch to running smoothly in EMEA, and adapt them to the region’s markets, languages and buying norms.

  • Partner with our AMER Field Ops Manager on SDR process, and make it work for our EMEA SDR team.

data.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.


What is the role: 

We are seeking a Thermal Engineer to own the thermal analysis and testing of our space products, such as sensors and actuators. The role centers on building thermal models and correlating them with test data, and on planning and running thermal test campaigns in house. It is a hands-on position: you will instrument and run tests yourself and use the results to improve both the design and our test infrastructure. This position is based in our Toulouse office. 


What you will do:

  • Develop and maintain thermal models (analytical and numerical) of units such as sensors and actuators, from early design trades to flight predictions. 

  • Perform thermal analyses (steady-state, transient, worst-case hot and cold) to support design reviews and recommend design changes. 

  • Define thermal test campaigns: test plans, predictions, temperature profiles, instrumentation, and pass/fail criteria from requirements and qualification margins. 

  • Operate our in-house thermal test facility: run thermal cycling tests, coordinate thermal vacuum (TVAC) campaigns, and own the test reports. 

  • Correlate models with test data to refine predictions and margins and feed the results back into the design. 

  • Improve our test infrastructure: identify capability gaps, specify and procure equipment, design fixtures and thermal interfaces, and commission new setups. 

  • Act as the thermal point of contact for our units toward the spacecraft team: unit thermal budgets, interface boundary conditions, and unit models for the spacecraft thermal model. 

  • Support spacecraft Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT) through system-level thermal balance testing.


    • What you bring to this role:

  • BS + 8 years / MS + 5 years in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Thermal Engineering, or equivalent, with professional experience in thermal engineering of space or electronic hardware. 

  • Solid grounding in space heat transfer: radiation in vacuum, conduction and contact conductance across bolted interfaces, and multi-layer insulation (MLI). 

  • Hands-on experience building thermal models with standard thermal analysis tools, running worst-case analyses, and correlating models with test data. 

  • Hands-on experience planning and running thermal tests (thermal cycling or TVAC) on space or electronic hardware, from test plan to test report. 

  • Ability to instrument a test article: thermocouple selection and bonding, heater sizing and placement, thermal interface materials, and data acquisition and real-time monitoring, with ESD-safe, clean handling of sensitive hardware. 

  • Excellent teamwork, communication, and documentation skills, with professional proficiency in English; comfortable in a hands-on, fast-paced startup environment.


    • Bonus points:

  • Experience with Python to post-process test data and automate model correlation. 

  • Experience designing or specifying thermal test equipment such as TVAC chambers, thermal plates, or shrouds. 

  • Knowledge of spacecraft thermal control hardware: heat pipes, radiators, coatings, and heater circuits. 

  • Experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate development, analysis, and documentation, with sound judgment about their limits.

You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment: our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment.

In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems: building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product.

  • Translate insights into iteration loops in production, by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes.

  • Experience with production systems (APIs, monitoring, optimization)

data.title: Senior Data Engineer - Financial Flows
data.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate resilient batch and real-time streaming data ingestion pipelines connecting to external financial market data providers via APIs and WebSockets.

  • Lead the architectural migration of legacy backend infrastructure to modern cloud-native environments on AWS, establishing high standards for system reliability and scalability.

  • Drive the refactoring and rewrite of the CTA positioning indicator calculation blocks from PHP to Python, ensuring strict mathematical output parity, comprehensive test coverage, and optimized latency.

  • Ingest and model complex financial datasets—including futures pricing, open interest, and trading volumes—across time-series stores and search engines like QuestDB and Elasticsearch.

  • Implement automated data validation, proactive alerting, and system monitoring to ensure market data feeds remain accurate, continuous, and fault-tolerant.

  • Deploy, maintain, and scale containerized services across Docker and Kubernetes environments using automated CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows.

  • Partner closely with quantitative researchers, commodity analysts, and product managers to translate complex trading models into high-performance production pipelines.

  • Provide technical mentorship to peer engineers, raising team-wide engineering rigor through thoughtful code reviews, system design guidance, and architectural documentation.


    • Experience & Background

    What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • 5+ years of professional experience building, operating, and scaling production-grade data pipelines and backend infrastructure.

  • Advanced expertise in Python, with a strong background refactoring and rewriting production-critical code for performance and testability.

  • Proven hands-on experience building and maintaining real-time or streaming API ingestion pipelines (REST, WebSockets) handling time-series datasets.

  • Solid production experience deploying and managing containerized applications on AWS using Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Strong database fundamentals in SQL and experience working with distributed search or time-series databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, QuestDB, ClickHouse).

  • Deep experience establishing automated data quality frameworks, observability (monitoring/alerting), and root-cause troubleshooting for production systems.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • Domain knowledge of financial market structures, futures contracts, open interest, and commodities trading symbology.

Dans ce contexte, notre dernière enquête interne a clairement fait émerger le besoin d’une communication interne plus lisible, plus régulière et mieux organisée. Pour y répondre, nous avons mené au deuxième semestre 2026 un audit de la communication interne et formulé des orientations pour la professionnaliser : une architecture, des porte-paroles, des standards pour les rituels et les annonces, une cascade d’information, de nouveaux formats et une feuille de route pour 2027. Pour y arriver, un bon outil IA ne suffit pas : il faut quelqu'un sur le terrain, au plus près des équipes du client, qui fait le lien entre leur réalité métier et nos agents et workflows IA.
Le Forward Deployed Engineer est ce profil : à moitié ingénieur, à moitié consultant, et toujours responsable du résultat en production.
 
Ton équipe :
Tu rejoins la practice AI Modernisation et tu es détaché chez nos clients. Tu travailles avec un AI Architect, un Tech Lead, des Software Engineers et un Product Manager, et tu t'appuies sur une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes.

Tes futures missions
  • Être en immersion chez le client : comprendre son métier, son SI, ses contraintes et ses équipes, et repérer où l'IA a le plus d'impact
  • Déployer et adapter nos workflows IA (agents, LLM, outillage de migration) sur le code et l'infrastructure du client
  • Coder au quotidien : prototyper vite, industrialiser, mettre en production, et ne pas t'arrêter tant que la valeur n'est pas constatée
  • Accélérer la modernisation du legacy : cartographier, refactorer et migrer avec l'IA, avec un haut niveau de qualité (Clean Code, tests automatisés, code reviews)
  • Faire monter en compétence les équipes du client : pair programming, revues de code, transmission des pratiques AI-native
  • Être la voix du terrain : remonter aux équipes produit et aux architectes Theodo ce qui marche et ce qui bloque, pour améliorer nos outils et nos standards
  • Contribuer au business : repérer de nouveaux cas d'usage chez le client et aider à construire les propositions

    • Exemples de projets
  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d'une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L'objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l'IA, nous passons d'une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : modernisation d'une application interne de gestion des campagnes marketing, avec des millions d'euros en jeu. 23 semaines pour passer de Vue Express à React Nest, et connexion à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

    • Ce que tu vas apprendre
  • Devenir un ingénieur AI-native de haut niveau, capable de livrer avec l'IA sur des systèmes complexes en conditions réelles

The Mission: Strategic Growth & Deep-Tech Advisory (Telecom Focus)

At Illuin Technology, we don't just "sell" software; we architect the AI future of the world’s largest organizations. As a Senior Account Executive specialized in Telecommunications, your mission is to manage a strategic portfolio of 5 to 10 major enterprise accounts within the Telco sector. You aren't just a vendor; you are a trusted advisor navigating high-stakes environments to deliver durable, multi-year partnerships with Tier-1 operators, ISPs, and infrastructure providers.

You will master a dual-track revenue model: driving multi-year licenses for our cutting-edge AI product suite while orchestrating high-impact strategic consulting projects. Your success is measured by your ability to penetrate complex telecom organizations, build C-Level intimacy, and turn technical excellence into sustainable commercial success.

Your DNA

  • The Telco Strategic Hunter: You thrive in the complexity of long sales cycles (6–12 months) specific to the telecommunications industry. You don't just wait for leads; you build account plans that map out stakeholders and influence the RFP (Appel d'Offres) before it’s even written. You have successfully answered and won major Telco RFPs in the past.

  • Industry Insider: You possess a profound understanding of the Telco landscape. You know the specific challenges of the sector—from 5G monetization and network optimization to OSS/BSS modernization and customer churn reduction—and you know how to leverage AI to address them.

  • Force Multiplier: You make the team better—sharing best practices, supporting peers, and stepping in when needed. Your presence increases the effectiveness and cohesion of the entire group and helps more junior team members.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Account Orchestration: Take full ownership of a targeted portfolio. You will define the strategy to expand our footprint exclusively within the Telecommunications sector.

  • Complex RFP Management: Lead and coordinate responses to highly complex, multi-million-euro Telco RFPs. You will mobilize internal resources to craft winning proposals tailored to operators' stringent requirements.

  • Full-Cycle Execution: From cold-start qualification (MEDDIC/BANT) to complex negotiations and closing. You’ll be expertly managing all stages of the sales process.

  • C-Suite Advisory: Act as the primary point of contact for C-Level as well as B-Level stakeholders in Telco organizations, identifying pain points and aligning them with Illuin’s AI roadmap.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with our Pre-sales, Products, and Engineering teams to ensure that the "vision" sold is technically sound and perfectly delivered.

  • Pipeline Rigor: Maintain extreme discipline in your CRM and forecasting. You understand that "hope is not a strategy" and rely on data to drive your activity.

Profile Requirements

  • Track Record & RFP Mastery: 10+ years of experience in consultative sales for Large Enterprise accounts, with a mandatory, verifiable track record of responding to and winning large-scale Telco RFPs. (Be prepared to provide concrete examples/track record during the process).

  • Deep Vertical Expertise: Exceptional knowledge and an active, existing network within the Telecommunications industry. You speak the language of Telco operators flawlessly.

  • Background: Ideally coming from a high-growth Scale-Up, a specialized Telco software vendor, or a Tier-1 Digital Transformation consultancy.

  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of Software/SaaS models and a genuine interest in Generative AI and Data ecosystems.

  • Methodology: Mastery of enterprise sales frameworks (MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, or similar).

  • Cognitive Ability: You are comfortable with numbers, mental math for on-the-spot business cases, and complex problem-solving.

  • Languages: Native-level French and professional fluency in English.

  • Logistics: Comfortable working from our HQ in La Défense (Paris) with a 1-day-per-week remote policy.

Why Join Us ?

  • Unrivaled Tech Stack: Sell the most advanced AI solutions in the market—products that are actually in production, not just "PowerPoint AI."

  • High Stakes, High Reward: Manage 5-10 accounts where your impact is visible and your commission is uncapped based on performance.

  • Culture of Excellence: Join a team of "Doers" where the Sales function is central to the company’s trajectory.

  • Prestige & Growth: Work at the intersection of a top-tier consultancy and a disruptive software editor.

The Selection Process

  • Talent Screen: A 30-minute screening focusing on your enterprise track record, Telco experience, and sales methodology.

  • The Deep Dive: Interview with the Head of Sales/Founders to discuss your past quotas, your specific Telco "war stories," and your RFP track record.

  • Sales Case Study: A simulated account planning and pitch session to demonstrate your consultative approach and "number crunching" skills on a realistic Telco scenario.

data.description:
Senior RevOps (H/F)

CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

Qui sommes-nous ?
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Votre mission :

Le ou la Senior RevOps Analyst est le bras technique du Head of RevOps : il ou elle construit et fait tourner la donnée, les automatisations et le reporting qui rendent l'ARR pilotable.

Intescia commercialise des solutions de data et d'intelligence commerciale B2B par abonnement. Les équipes Sales, Account Management, Marketing et Customer Success travaillent dans Salesforce et HubSpot ; le reporting ARR groupe est produit dans Power BI. Les écarts entre CRM et reporting, les renouvellements suivis tardivement et les churns découverts après coup coûtent du temps et de la visibilité.

La mission : fiabiliser les données, outiller les process définis avec le Head of RevOps et livrer aux équipes des analyses et cockpits sur lesquels elles peuvent agir. Poste d'expert individuel, sans management.

Vos activités :

Données et reporting Revenue (Sales Metrics, ARR, NRR, Churn, etc..)

•       Construire et maintenir les modèles de données et tableaux de bord ARR dans Power BI : new business, upsell, downsell, churn, NRR/GRR, par entité, segment et portefeuille.

•       Réconcilier Salesforce, HubSpot et le reporting groupe ; identifier la cause de chaque écart et corriger à la source.

•       Préparer les données et analyses du forecast mensuel et trimestriel pour le Head of RevOps.

 

Gestion CRM (Salesforce, Hubspot) & de la roadmap IA

•       Administrer Salesforce et HubSpot au quotidien : propriétés, pipelines, workflows, séquences, droits et rapports.

•       Traduire les process définis par le Head of RevOps en configuration : étapes, champs obligatoires, alertes de renouvellement à J-120 / J-90 / J-30.

•       Garantir la qualité des données : règles de saisie, dédoublonnage, contrôles automatiques.

•       Mise en place et suivi d’une roadmap IA pour les équipes revenues

Intégrations et automatisation

•       Construire et maintenir les intégrations de la stack go-to-market (facturation, enrichissement, analyse d'appels, BI) via API, n8n ou outils équivalents.

•       Automatiser les tâches répétitives des équipes et du reporting, y compris avec des LLMs (agents, enrichissement, synthèses).

•       Documenter chaque flux, modèle et règle de calcul.

Analyses et support aux équipes

•       Livrer les cockpits portefeuille des Account Managers : comptes à risque, échéances, opportunités d'upsell.

•         Produire les analyses ad hoc demandées par le Head of RevOps : conversion, cycle de vente, couverture pipeline, cohortes de churn.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Expérience

•       3 à 5 ans en RevOps, Sales Ops, Business Analytics ou data, dont au moins 2 dans un éditeur SaaS ou un modèle par abonnement.

•       Expérience concrète d'administration Salesforce, obligatoire ; HubSpot fortement apprécié. Expérience de construction de reporting ARR.

•       Un plus : contexte multi-entités ou harmonisation de données hétérogènes après acquisition.

Vos compétences :

  • Maitrise experte de SalesForce obligatoire

  • Métriques SaaS : ARR, NRR, GRR, churn…

  • LLMs

Nous produisons des données à forte valeur ajoutée pour accompagner le développement commercial des entreprises, faciliter leurs analyses de marchés et optimiser leur connaissance clients. Nous comptons aujourd’hui plus de 1 500 clients et près de 35 000 utilisateurs dans les univers de l’Immobilier, la Construction, l’Énergie, l’Environnement et des Services à l’entreprise.

Nos atouts ?

  • Un groupe en pleine expansion, reconnu pour son expertise et ses solutions à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Une culture d’innovation, où la créativité et l’amélioration continue sont au cœur de notre ADN.

  • Des équipes passionnées et engagées, évoluant dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif.

Votre mission :

Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data Engineer qui joue un rôle central chez Intescia : ingérer, structurer, fiabiliser et valoriser la donnée vendue aux clients. Vous intégrerez une entreprise en pleine transformation data : migration de la donnée dans Databricks.

En tant que Senior Data Engineer vous aurez un rôle clé dans la mise en place de cette transformation : conception et développement des pipelines de données, mise en place et diffusion des bonnes pratiques de développement et optimisation des performances.

Un des axes majeurs de la donnée traitée par Intescia est l’axe géographique. Vous prenez le relais de notre géomaticien qui évolue vers une autre équipe : vous avez de l’appétence et de l’expérience dans le traitement de la donnée géographique.

Vos activités :

Construire et industrialiser les pipelines de données

·         Concevoir, développer et maintenir les pipelines d'ingestion et de transformation de données.

·         Garantir la fiabilité, la fraîcheur, la qualité et la traçabilité des données produites.

·         Mettre en place le monitoring, les tests, l'alerting et la documentation associée.

Porter la migration vers Databricks

·         Contribuer activement à la conception de la cible : organisation du DataLakehouse, Unity Catalog, gouvernance, modèle de données.

·         Migrer les traitements existants et poser les standards (structuration des jobs, CI/CD, conventions, revue de code).

·         Diffuser les bonnes pratiques Spark / Delta au sein de l'équipe et accompagner sa montée en compétences.

Prendre en charge la dimension géographique

·         Industrialiser les traitements géospatiaux : géocodage, appariement d'adresses, jointures spatiales, agrégations par mailles administratives, gestion des projections et des référentiels.

·         Être le point de contact de l'équipe sur les référentiels géographiques et leurs évolutions.

Assumer un rôle de leadership technique

·         Être garant·e de la cohérence technique des solutions produites par l'équipe.

·         Animer les choix d'architecture, arbitrer et documenter les décisions.

·         Accompagner et faire monter en compétences les autres membres de l'équipe (revues de code, pair programming).

Stack technique

·         Environnement : Databricks

·         Langages : Python, SQL

·         Framework : Spark

·         Databases : ElasticSearch, Postgres

·         DevOps : Github Action (CI/CD), Docker

·         Monitoring : Grafana, Prometheus

  • La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera entre 55K€ et 60K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons.

Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vos compétences :

  • L’usage de DATABRICKS sera un critère fortement apprécié

  • Capacité à porter techniquement un sujet de bout en bout et à embarquer les autres.

  • Clarté et transparence dans la communication

  • Leadership, référent au sein d'une équipe.

Expérience :

  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en data engineering, sur des pipelines en production.

  • Très bonne maîtrise de Python et de SQL.

  • Très bonne maitrise du traitement de données distribué : Spark (PySpark).

  • Solide expérience de développement de pipelines de données sur Databricks

  • Pratique des standards d'ingénierie logicielle : Git, CI/CD, tests automatisés, revue de code, performance.

  • Expérience de l'orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows ou équivalent).

  • Appétence réelle pour la donnée géographique : vous en avez déjà manipulé.

  • Compréhension des systèmes de projection (WGS84, Lambert 93) et des formats géospatiaux (GeoJSON, Shapefile, WFS etc).

  • Connaissance de PostGis (SQL Spatial) et QGIS.

data.title: Data Analyst (Maternity Cover / Temporary contract)
data.description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion connecting millions of buyers and sellers across the world. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and Brooklyn, we combine the desirability of luxury with the trust and rigour that make buying pre-loved effortless and safe.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.


Data Analyst - Operations

Full-time Temporary position based in Paris.

Timeline: From December 1st 2026 until June or July 2027.

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst as part of the Product Team and reporting to the Data Product Lead, and working closely with the Customer Experience & Operations Products & Tech teams.

We are seeking for someone with exceptional skills in SQL and a strong emphasis on impact assessment.

You will be defining KPIs, creating dashboards and analyzing data to generate hypotheses, targets and follow up on the impact we generate for our customers and the company.

You will advocate for data driven culture, as well objective analysis over the impact of our work.

This is a full-time, Temporary role based in our Ho Chi Minh City office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure the proper definition and monitoring of the team KPIs & OKRs

  • Support Customer Experience & Operations Product managers with data analysis for specific business cases.

  • Conduct data querying and analysis, supporting the team in providing actionable data insights that lead to measurable impact.

  • Create reports & dashboards for communicating insights with stakeholders.

  • Work on A/B test setup and analysis to validate core hypotheses and assess the impact of product changes.

  • Manage stakeholder relationships and facilitate data-driven decision-making.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics/Business (with a data focus), Engineering, or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in data & product analytics, preferably in e-commerce and operations, you adapt quickly in fast-paced environments.

  • Proficient in SQL. (Experience in Python is a plus)

  • You’re curious about AI and how it can improve your work, and keen to explore practical ways to use it in your day-to-day activities. 

  • Experienced in statistical methods and experimentation.

  • Skilled in data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

  • Strong communication skills in English. 

  • A team player who is structured, detail-oriented, and thrives in a startup environment.

  • Passionate about the fashion/luxury industry.

What we offer

  • A rare chance to own two of the most important, unsolved problems at the world's leading pre-loved luxury platform — trust and desirability.

  • Proximity to our Engineering team in HCMC — ship fast, learn fast, build together.

  • The chance to shape how AI transforms authentication, fraud prevention and product imagery.
