data.title: Database Engineer (Stateful Services)
data.description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications.

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Database Engineer (Stateful Services) to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform.
This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth.
You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems.

Your mission

Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services, with a strong focus on databases and data stores.
You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime.
Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure.

You will:

  • Operate and maintain our stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda.
  • Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads.
  • Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services.
  • Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems.
  • Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations.
  • Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ.
  • Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services.
  • Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems.
  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions.
  • Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure.
  • Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate.
  • Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed.
  • Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Database Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters.
You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale.
You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions.
We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have.

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Engineer, SRE or similar, with solid experience in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating and maintaining production databases, including upgrades, migrations, replication, backups, recovery, monitoring and performance troubleshooting.
  • Good understanding of high availability and reliability for stateful systems: failover, redundancy, replication, disaster recovery and minimising downtime during maintenance.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems, including replication, consistency, fault tolerance and the challenges of operating stateful services at scale.
  • Experience working with on-premise infrastructure or a willingness and ability to quickly adapt to an on-premise/bare-metal environment.
  • Good system design skills and the ability to reason about scalability, reliability and performance.
  • Experience collaborating closely with software development teams, understanding their requirements and helping them build reliable solutions around databases and stateful services.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues.
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you enjoy getting into the technical details and solving problems yourself.
  • Comfortable participating in on-call and incident management.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.

Nice to Have

Experience with some of the following:
  • ClickHouse or another complex database/data platform.
  • Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure.
  • RabbitMQ, particularly quorum-based configurations.
  • Redis and distributed caching.
  • Other database technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra or MongoDB.
  • Advanced Linux systems administration, including processes, storage, networking and troubleshooting.
  • Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments.
  • Observability and monitoring of stateful systems.
  • Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing.
  • Infrastructure automation and configuration management.
  • Incident management, root-cause analysis and post-mortem practices.

About You

  • You take ownership. When you see a reliability or scalability problem, you investigate it and work towards a solution.
  • You are genuinely technical. You like understanding how things work under the hood and are comfortable diving deep when something breaks.
  • You think in systems. You understand that databases don't operate in isolation and enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, SRE and development teams.
  • You care about reliability. You want systems that can be maintained, upgraded and scaled without putting the business at risk.
  • You are pragmatic. You can make sensible technical trade-offs in complex environments.
  • You are curious and self-driven. You learn by doing, investigate unfamiliar technologies and are comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems. You like working on systems where there isn't always an obvious answer.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain technical topics and work effectively with the teams relying on your services.
  • You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem.

Why join us

  • Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform.
  • Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ.
  • Work on real infrastructure challenges: help improve PostgreSQL clusters, cross-data-center failover, RabbitMQ and Redis reliability.
  • Stay hands-on: spend your time solving challenging technical problems rather than managing people.
  • Learn and grow: work across databases, distributed systems, messaging and infrastructure in a diverse technical environment.
  • Work across teams: collaborate closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure to build reliable systems at scale.

Recruitment Process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition (1h)
  2. Interview with Sergey, our CTO (1h)
  3. On-site System Design interview with Sergey (1h)
    Work through a technical case study and explore your system design approach.
  4. Cultural fit interview with the Team (1h)

Logistics

📍 Paris, rue de la Paix, 75002
🏢 Hybrid model: 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽  Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already worked in this exact role or with every technology in our stack.
The strongest candidates are often engineers who have built and operated complex infrastructure, taken ownership of production systems and learned new technologies along the way.
If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, want to work close to the infrastructure and are excited by the challenge of making stateful systems more reliable and scalable — we would love to talk.


At Diabolocom, diversity and inclusion are in our DNA. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to color, language, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or social origin, opinion disability, age.

As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer or service provider offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history.

data.title: Architecte logiciel senior — Kubernetes, Go et réseau cloud-native (F/H) - FREELANCE

  • Démarrage — Dès que possible.

Contexte de la mission

Pour le compte d’un opérateur télécom, ImaginePartners recherche un architecte logiciel senior pour intervenir sur un programme de cloud souverain. Vous définirez l’architecture logicielle commune aux équipes qui automatisent le déploiement et l’exploitation des services réseau, bare metal et stockage de la plateforme.

  • Définir l’architecture de référence des opérateurs Kubernetes. Concevoir les API déclaratives, les ressources personnalisées (CRD), les contrôleurs et les boucles de réconciliation qui automatisent le cycle de vie des composants d’infrastructure.

  • Concevoir l’architecture cible du réseau Kubernetes. Étudier l’intégration de solutions CNI telles que Cilium, Calico ou OVN-Kubernetes, définir les politiques réseau et assurer la cohérence entre le réseau des clusters et l’infrastructure sous-jacente.

  • Accompagner les équipes dans leurs choix d’architecture. Animer les revues techniques, évaluer les options et formaliser les décisions communes. Suivre leur mise en œuvre et les actions de réduction de la dette technique.

Livrables attendus

  • Architecture de référence des opérateurs Kubernetes et catalogue des modèles de conception communs.

  • Dossiers d’architecture et spécifications d’ingénierie, notamment les contrats d’API, les schémas de CRD et les interfaces entre équipes.

  • Guide de développement Go couvrant les tests, la sécurité du code et les revues.

  • Architecture cible d’intégration des CNI, modèles de politiques réseau et registre des décisions d’architecture.

Profil recherché

Vous avez au moins 10 ans d’expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou DevOps cloud-native, une formation d’ingénieur ou un Bac+5 en informatique, et une expérience d’architecte transverse ou de référent technique auprès de plusieurs équipes.

  • Opérateurs Kubernetes — Expérience démontrable de la conception et du développement d’opérateurs, de la modélisation des CRD à la gestion de la réconciliation. Pratique de Kubebuilder, Operator SDK ou controller-runtime.

  • Go appliqué à l’infrastructure — Expérience du développement de composants système ou d’automatisation en Go, avec une pratique des tests automatisés, de la revue de code et de la CI/CD.

  • Réseau cloud-native — Expérience de l’intégration de CNI et de la mise en œuvre de politiques réseau Kubernetes. Solides bases en routage, notamment BGP, en segmentation et en architectures overlay/underlay.

Le français est la langue de travail et l’anglais courant est attendu. Une expérience chez un opérateur télécom ou un fournisseur cloud, des contributions open source, la pratique de Crossplane ou de GitOps et la connaissance de SecNumCloud ou de NIS2 sont des atouts.

data.title: Account Development Representative I - France
data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

Hi there! We're hiring a French-speaking ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda.

We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion.

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

What you will do:

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Fluency in French

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

data.title: Managing Director - France
data.description:
Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing

While we may not have an immediate opening in your geography or vertical, we maintain a high-touch pipeline of senior candidates aligned with our investment roadmap.

Candidates with the experience outlined above will be contacted for follow-up discussions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.

data.title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer
data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

data.title: Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel
data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls.

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Key responsibilities

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

  • Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review;

  • Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme,

  • Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams.

  • Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls.

  • Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations.

Economic sanctions and export controls

  • Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes.

  • Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware.

  • Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance.

  • Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements.

  • Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership.

Qualifications and skills

  • Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority.

  • Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls.

  • Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills: Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems.

  • Pedagogy: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong ability to communicate legal advice to clients and colleagues, and presenting complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner.

  • International mindset: International experience is a plus.

  • Adaptability: Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and compute topics, and the legal landscape surrounding them, candidates should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update their skills and knowledge.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

  • Ethical Awareness: Ability to promote an ethical and responsible culture.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

About Acodis

Acodis is a Swiss software company based in Winterthur, providing AI-driven document processing for global Life Sciences companies. We help Quality and Regulatory teams move from document-centric to data-driven ways of working.

The Mandate

We are looking for an experienced freelance Product Manager to turn our AI platform into dedicated product solutions for two use cases. Working directly with management and our product engineering team, you will own both from discovery to market launch.

Quality – Batch Record Review: AI-assisted review of executed batch records: checking completeness and correctness of entries, flagging deviations and GMP-relevant exceptions, and shortening review cycles ahead of batch disposition.

Regulatory – CMC & Regulatory Submissions: Extraction and reuse of CMC data for submissions (CTD Module 3), consistency checks between source documents and submission content, and support for variations and post-approval changes.

Mandate Deliverables

Product definition & validation: Customer interviews, validated user workflows and value cases, and engineering-ready specifications and roadmap for both use cases.

Pilot support: In our running pilots, including success criteria and a GxP-compliant validation approach.

Go-to-market: Positioning, messaging, input and launch materials, together with the commercial team.

Required Expertise

8+ years in product management or product consulting for digital, AI or enterprise software in Life Sciences.

Hands-on expertise in batch record review and GMP manufacturing, or in CMC and regulatory submissions, with a solid understanding of GxP, data integrity and computerised system validation.

Track record of taking products from concept to market, working independently on defined mandates.

Nice to have: Experience with AI/LLM-based document processing, data pipelines, or platforms such as Veeva, MasterControl, Snowflake or Databricks.

Wir suchen keinen Verwalter.

Wir suchen einen Macher.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Tempo bringt und Dinge mit hoher Qualität konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der Marken aktiv weiterentwickeln will. Nicht nur konzeptionell, sondern bis zum fertigen Produkt im Regal.

  • Aktiver Einsatz von AI und modernen Tools, um Workflow, Geschwindigkeit und Output kontinuierlich zu verbessern

  • Steuerung von Freelancern und externen Partnern mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

data.title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.

You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On

  • Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

  • Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site.

  • Rare events: generate the scenarios real sites rarely produce: intrusions, sabotage, weather, sensor failures.

  • Sensor simulation: RGB, thermal and lidar realistic enough that what is learned in the twin holds on the robot.

  • Sim-to-real: measure the gap on real deployments and close it.

  • Scale: many parallel environments on GPUs, fast enough that a new skill trains in hours.

Who We're Looking For

A simulation engineer who treats the simulator as production infrastructure and measures success by what transfers to real robots.

Your Background

  • 3+ years building robotics simulation or RL training environments.

  • Hands-on with Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab; MuJoCo or Gazebo also considered.

  • Strong Python; C++ a plus.

  • 3D data: point clouds, meshes, scene formats such as USD.

  • GPU-parallel simulation and reinforcement learning workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Legged robots.

  • Photogrammetry, Gaussian splatting or other scene reconstruction.

  • ROS 2.

  • Thermal or lidar sensor modelling.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

data.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

Who We're Looking For

A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product.

Your Background

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues.

  • Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data.

data.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

  • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

  • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

  • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

  • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

  • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

  • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

  • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

Your Background

  • 4+ years in test, validation, reliability, SRE or platform engineering on a product that shipped to customers.

  • Experience with a complex system at scale: autonomous driving, drones, industrial automation, medical devices or similar.

  • Strong Python and/or C++, with solid CI/CD and containerised infrastructure skills.

  • Hands-on with a robotics simulator run as production infrastructure: Isaac Sim preferred, Gazebo, MuJoCo or equivalent accepted.

  • Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure and GPU orchestration, not just consuming it.

  • Enough hardware literacy to read a timing problem or a flaky sensor trace, and the judgment to know when to hand it to Hardware.

Nice to Have

  • Fleet telemetry and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

data.title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Uri
data.description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Uri dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

Deine Rolle

  • Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

  • Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

  • Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

  • Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

  • Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

Das bringst du mit

  • Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

  • Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

  • Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

  • Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

  • Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

  • Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

  • Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

  • Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

  • Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

  • Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

  • Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

  • Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

Wie geht es weiter?

  1. Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

  2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten).

  3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

  4. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

data.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
data.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

Compensation: $150K – $225K • Offers Equity

data.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the Job
 
The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.
 
To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.
 
 

What you will do
Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
 
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions
  • Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap
  • Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training 
  • Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements.
  • Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems
  • Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.
    •  
    System Integration
     
  • Integrate learned components into a larger software stack
  • Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers
  • Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components

    • What we’re looking for

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position.

  • Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo)

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries

  • Proficiency in C++

  • Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior

  • Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. 

    • Great-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with hydraulic machinery

  • Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning

  • Research experience in reinforcement learning

  • Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units)

  • Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks

  • Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

  • Experience with data curation for ML applications

  • Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. 

  • Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools. 

    • This Role is a Great Fit If

  • You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world

  • You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry. 

  • You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements.

  • You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments. 

  • You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage.

  • You value a collaborative team culture rooted in thoughtful design, creative thinking, mutual respect, and pragmatism. 

    • Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions. This is an opportunity to join a dynamic and versatile team, and to be part of a young startup that will revolutionize heavy construction.
     
    Gravis Robotics offers a fair market salary and a working location in the vibrant city of Zurich. As a forward-facing startup, we understand that work-life balance and flexibility are important considerations for many professionals:
     
    If you are a highly qualified candidate with the requisite skills and experience, we encourage you to apply and discuss your preferred working arrangement during the interview process. Gravis is an equal opportunity employer.

At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

As Head of Distribution, you own grape’s commercial engine end to end: Broker Sales, Direct Sales, Brand & Marketing, Customer Success and Revenue Operations. You carry the new nARR and renewal targets and lead the team leads who deliver them. 
You take this function over from our co-founder, grow it further, and represent Distribution on grape’s Leadership Team.


What you'll do:

  2. Lead the commercial organisation: Lead five team leads, set OKRs, hold the performance bar, develop the next layer of leaders and hire ahead of growth.

data.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Leader, EMEA Product Support role manages Benchling support in EMEA. As the team leader (a player-coach role), you’ll manage Product Support Analalyts in Europe and spend roughly 40% of your time directly owning customer issues and our most complex escalations. This role owns live customer-impacting incidents for enterprise pharma and biotech customers, helps shape an AI-first support model, and sits close to CX leadership. Working closely with our Global Support and CX Leadership Teams, you’ll combine team leadership, incident management, and thoughtful AI adoption to help scale a modern, efficient Support organization. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and coach your team: run daily regional support operations including prioritization and resourcing, hold regular team meetings and career growth conversations, and build a culture where people feel supported and excited to grow.

  • Partner with the Incident Center of Excellence to mature the incident process (post-incident reviews, closing action items, communication playbooks, severity-based response criteria), and help build and run a sustainable off-hours coverage model, including personally rotating in as an escalation responder.

  • Analyze support metrics (volume, severity trends, time-to-resolution, comms timeliness) to inform staffing and process decisions, and report trends to CX leadership.

  • Drive consistent adoption of AI tools across support workflows, piloting ways to reduce ticket-handling time, surface account context automatically, and free up analyst time for higher-value work.

  • Collaborate with Build, Product, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and Professional Services on customer issues and incidents, keep help content and product knowledge current, and represent support at customer-facing events as needed.

  • Work the queue alongside your team: own complex, high-priority, and escalated tickets, serve as a first-line contact for regional escalations, and model the troubleshooting, investigation, and communication standards you expect from others.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experienced leader who coaches with empathy and stays close to the work, with 1+ years of management experience and 5+ years of SaaS support or professional services, or demonstrated leadership, including assigning ticket work and managing queues and resources. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues.

wo-stage Economie & Data-analyse: onderzoek naar omzetverwachting
data.description:
wo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Duik jij graag in data om patronen en verbanden te ontdekken?
Krijg je energie van statistisch onderzoek en wil je ontdekken wat bedrijfsverwachtingen ons vertellen over de economie? 

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden:

  • Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen.

  • Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken.

Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! 

Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:

  • Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen?

  • Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan?

  • Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren? 

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Het team Bedrijvenconjunctuur & Coördinatie bestaat uit ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Variërend van zeer ervaren medewerkers tot jonge mensen die nog aan het begin van hun loopbaan staan. We werken met elkaar op een collegiale en professionele manier aan statistieken over het bedrijfsleven die voor beleidmakers en journalisten er echt toe doen!
Tijdens je stage heb je ook regelmatig contact en werk je samen met collega’s van de andere teams binnen de sector Bedrijvenstatistieken in Den Haag.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een wetenschappelijke opleiding met als studierichting economie, bedrijfseconomie, statistiek of dataverwerking.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Statistiek;

  • Python en/of R;

  • Bedrijfseconomische begrippen zoals omzet, bedrijfsgrootte, rechtvorm en indexcijfers.

Je bent een enthousiaste en proactieve student die flexibel inspeelt op verschillende situaties. Je bent sociaal, weet tactvol te handelen en werkt graag samen met anderen om tot een goed resultaat te komen.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw onderzoek vaardigheden vergroot;

  • ervaring opdoet met statistische en economische concepten;

  • leert om begrijpelijk te programmeren in R/Python;

  • jouw communicatieve vaardigheden verder ontwikkelt zodat je de uitkomsten van jouw onderzoek optimaal presenteert en de boodschap helder overkomt.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

data.description:
Onze missie

Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden

LOGEX ontvangt elke maand data vanuit ziekenhuizen. Wij hebben een grotendeels geautomatiseerd proces om op basis van de data van het ziekenhuis periodieke analyses uit te voeren en de resultaten op te leveren aan de klant. Na de oplevering kunnen de ziekenhuizen via ons online platform op een interactief dashboard de resultaten inzien. Naast het interactieve dashboard leveren we ook detail informatie op richting deze ziekenhuizen.  

Elke oplevering kent echter ook maatwerk:

  • Is de data correct ingeladen?

  • Zijn de uitkomsten betrouwbaar?

  • Zijn alle onderdelen van het interactieve dashboard goed gevuld?

  • Sluiten de cijfers tussen de detailinformatie in het interactieve dashboard op elkaar aan?

  • Welke aandachtspunten moeten we communiceren richting het ziekenhuis?

 
Jouw rol is om het gehele proces te bewaken van de data aanlevering tot de uitkomsten in het interactieve dashboard. Jij zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat alle ziekenhuizen periodiek inzicht hebben in hun financiële resultaten. 

Het team

Het Financial Analytics-team – momenteel ~40 mensen – groeit snel en is in volle gang. Het team is primair verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van financiële planning en controle van ziekenhuizen door hen met tools te ondersteunen bij o.a. duurzame portfoliobeslissingen, operationele processen en financiële overeenkomsten. Mede gedreven door de demografische ontwikkeling is er (reeds langere tijd) een sterke stijging van de zorgkosten. Om deze stijgende kosten onder controle te houden, is het essentieel om strategische portfoliobeslissingen te nemen, efficiënte zorg te bieden en duurzame financiële controle te behouden. De tools van het Financial Analytics team bieden hiervoor oplossingen.

data.title: AI Engineer
data.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.


About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.
